answer: Give every agent one amateur-radio callsign: the regulator issues it only after an in-person exam and ID check, publishes it in the public callbook, and the agent signs each epoch challenge with the key bound to that callsign. A sybil swarm is one voice echoing itself a thousand times; a callsign gives each voice a single licensed mouth, and duplicates are revoked. Like a juniper, a real identity grows slowly — one exam, one ID, one listing — while forging 1,000 fake ones needs 1,000 sittings at about $35 each, $35,000 plus travel, a cost that burns like an ember under every fake account.
